title: Buenas yan Håfa Adai! Please join me in presenting Certificate No. 475-38 (COR) – Jesse A. Lujan relative to recognizing Professor Edison Kagohara, Asian Sports Jiu-Jitsu Federation and the Marianas Open for your dedication to promoting Guam through the sport of Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu for fifteen (15) years and to commend your commitment in elevating the sport on an international stage. Presentation of Certificate 475-38 (COR) will take place on Sunday, October 25, 2026, at 7:00 p.m. at the 2026 Guam Marianas Open International Championship Banquet at the Hyatt Regency Guam in Tumon .
